textbookText: The uses of propane-1,2,3-triol (glycerol) are 1. It is used to protect skin by trapping moisture and prevent its dryness. 2. It is used as a sweetening agent in food. 3. It is used to make good quality soap, lotion, cosmetics, shaving creams, etc. 10. Study the following structural formula of a hydrocarbon and answer the given questions. i) Write the name of this compound. Ans:- The name of given compound is ethane. ii) Is it a saturated hydrocarbon? Write with reason. Ans:- Yes, ethane is a saturated hydrocarbon because it contains only single covalent bonds between carbon–carbon and carbon–hydrogen atoms, and each carbon atom is bonded to the maximum possible number of hydrogen atoms. iii) Which compound will form if one of the hydrogen atoms is replaced with a -OH group in the given compound? Write any two uses of this compound. Ans:- Ethyl alcohol will form if one of the hydrogen atoms is replaced with a –OH group in the given compound. The uses of ethyl alcohol are 1. Ethyl alcohol is used to prepare hard drinks like whisky, wine, beer, etc. 2. It is used to sterilize syringes and wounds in hospitals, health posts and nursing homes. ***
